mailProviders.brevo.dataRegionNote: An EU company: data is stored in France and Germany.
mailProviders.brevo.freeTierNote: 300 emails a day, no card needed. A new account may have to wait for approval before it can send.
mailProviders.brevo.passwordHint: An SMTP key from the same page — not the API key.
mailProviders.brevo.usernameHint: The SMTP login shown under Settings → SMTP & API (it usually ends in @smtp-brevo.com).
mailProviders.custom.passwordHint: The password or key for that user.
mailProviders.custom.usernameHint: The user name your mail server or relay gave you. Leave it empty if it needs none.
mailProviders.gmail.freeTierNote: About 500 emails a day. Mail comes from your Gmail address, not your own domain: for testing and small closed groups only.
mailProviders.gmail.passwordHint: An app password (it needs 2-Step Verification) — not your Google password.
mailProviders.mailgun.dataRegionNote: Choose the EU region to keep messages in the EU. The region is fixed per sending domain.
mailProviders.mailgun.freeTierNote: 100 emails a day and one domain; logs are kept for one day.
mailProviders.mailgun.passwordHint: The SMTP password of that login — not your account password or an API key.
mailProviders.mailgun.usernameHint: The SMTP login of your sending domain, for example postmaster@mg.example.org. Domains created through the API need their SMTP credentials added by hand.
mailProviders.mailjet.dataRegionNote: Data is stored on servers in the EU.
mailProviders.mailjet.freeTierNote: 6,000 emails a month, at most 200 a day. Free emails carry the Mailjet logo.
mailProviders.mailpit.dataRegionNote: Development only: Mailpit catches every email and sends nothing out. From your computer use localhost, port 19525; inside Docker Compose use mailpit, port 1025. Its inbox is at http://localhost:19526.
mailProviders.resend.dataRegionNote: You can send from the EU (Ireland), but account data is stored in the US.
mailProviders.scaleway.dataRegionNote: A French provider: data is hosted and processed in the EU (Paris).
mailProviders.scaleway.passwordHint: The secret key of an IAM API key that may send Transactional Email.
mailProviders.scaleway.pricingNote: 300 emails a month free per organization, then about €0.25 per 1,000. A new account needs a payment method and identity check.
mailProviders.ses.dataRegionNote: Choose an EU region (Frankfurt, eu-central-1, is the default) to send from the EU. SMTP credentials work in one region only.
mailProviders.ses.passwordHint: The SMTP password shown once when the credentials are created — not your AWS secret access key.
mailProviders.ses.pricingNote: About $0.10 per 1,000 emails on the pay-as-you-go plan. New accounts start on the Essentials plan ($0.16 per 1,000; you can cancel it in the SES console) and in the sandbox (200 emails a day, to verified addresses only) until production access is approved.
mailProviders.ses.usernameHint: The SMTP user name from the SES console (SMTP settings → Create SMTP credentials) — not your AWS access key.
mailProviders.smtp2go.dataRegionNote: Choose the EU host to send through their European servers.
mailProviders.smtp2go.freeTierNote: 1,000 emails a month, at most 200 a day, and 25 an hour until your sender domain is verified.
mailProviders.smtp2go.passwordHint: The password you set for that SMTP user.
mailProviders.smtp2go.usernameHint: An SMTP user you create under Sending → SMTP Users.
